text:
sarah_marketing: Hey team — idea: run an "Ecosystem Hacks Week" (3 mini tutorials + 1 live lightning demo + a short benchmark snapshot blog) to drive community signups and collect demo leads. Goal: low-effort, high-velocity content we can reuse across channels. Thoughts?

tony_devrel: love it. keep it snackable (5–10min each). can we pair each mini tutorial with a tiny refapp repo and a short benchmark table (latency/cost for 1k tokens) so folks can compare? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

lina_product: +1. lean into real dev workflows: e.g., "embed search for docs", "chatOps for infra runbooks", "rerank for support triage". each tutorial should have a clear CTA: try the refapp, claim a trial token, or sign up for the lightning demo.

jenna_design: I can whip up a visual kit: 1 hero image per tutorial + a 3-card email banner. Need exact copy + repo links by EOD Wed to make art.

omar_eng: I can produce tiny benchmark scripts for each refapp. plan: run benchmarks on our hosted API and Dedicated configs (small batch sizes) and capture p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost/token. output will be a CSV and a markdown table. sample command:
```bash
# run microbench (python)
python microbench.py --model redwood-mini --seq-len 512 --batch 8 --requests 200
```
I'll push results to the repo under /benchmarks/*.md.

sarah_marketing: Nice — inbound routing: we want signups to be tracked and routed to two buckets: (1) Community leads (newsletter + trials) and (2) Sales-qualified (high-usage orgs). Proposed routing: sign-up form includes company size + use-case field. Zapier -> Segment traits -> HubSpot with lead_score rule. Anyone have objections?

tony_devrel: that works. recommend adding a lightweight email capture modal on the refapp demo page with a UTM-based hidden field so we can map campaign_source. Also: add a checkbox "I'd like to join the lightning demo" so we get demo RSVPs.

lina_product: For messaging, we should A/B test two angles: "Build fast with minimal ops" vs "Save 50% on inference cost". Landing variants and GA events, track CTR -> signups. We'll run for first 48h and iterate.

jenna_design: For the A/B assets I need headline + 25-word blurb per variant. Sarah, can you draft both?

sarah_marketing: Sure. Drafts incoming by EOD. Also propose a short benchmark narrative: "Lightweight refapps show 30–60% cost improvement using Redwood Optimize heuristics + quantized models". We should be careful — use measured numbers only. Omar, can you run a quick baseline vs optimized run?

omar_eng: Yes. I'll run baseline (float32) and optimized (int8 + KV cache) and produce delta numbers. Expect results in 24h.

tony_devrel: Webinar plan: 30m demo (2x refapps), 15m Q&A. Panel hosts: Tony + Lina. Timing: week after content drops (gives people time to play). I'll own the registration flow + Slack invite.

comm_bot: reminder: marketing calendar slot check — "Ecosystem Hacks Week" proposed for Aug 12–16. No calendar conflicts found.

sarah_marketing: Great — owners recap:
- Content mini-tutorials (3): Tony + Jenna (assets)
- Refapp repos + benchmarks: Omar + Tony
- Landing + sign-up form + routing: Lina + Sarah
- Live demo + registration: Tony
- Copy A/B variants: Sarah + Lina
- Design assets: Jenna

tony_devrel: timeline suggestion:
- Wed this week: copy + repo stubs ready
- Fri: design + landing up on staging
- Mon next week: benchmarks final, social teasers scheduled
- Wed next week: content goes live, registration open for demo

jenna_design: noted. will queue assets after copy.

lina_product: I'll prepare the tracking spec (GA events + HubSpot fields). Sarah, where should we host the benchmark CSVs? repo + public gist?

sarah_marketing: Put them in the public refapp repo under /benchmarks and mirror a static snapshot on the blog post. Include a short methodology note.

omar_eng: Quick note: need to lock model version and instance sizes in the benchmark metadata. I'll include a small header like: "model: redwood-mini v1.2, instance: g4dn.xlarge" so results are reproducible.

tony_devrel: Also add a short "how we measured" blurb in each tutorial repo README. Keeps reviewers honest.

sarah_marketing: OK next steps: Tony to create 3 repo skeletons (toy-data + README); Omar to run baseline + optimized bench; Jenna to produce hero + email banners; Lina + Sarah to build landing + forms. Check-in Friday 10am.

jenna_design: ping me in #design if you change copy after EOD.

sarah_marketing: thanks team. I'll post a one-pager with the launch narrative + tracking checklist after this thread. :rocket:

omar_eng: will drop initial bench CSV tomorrow.

tony_devrel: I'll mock up the RSVP modal HTML and share snippet here.

tony_devrel: ```html
<form id="rsvp">
 <input name="email" type="email" required />
 <input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="ecosystem-hacks-week" />
 <label><input name="demo_interest" type="checkbox" value="yes"> Join lightning demo</label>
 <button type="submit">RSVP</button>
</form>
```

sarah_marketing: solid. I'll loop in growth for small ad test. Any blockers?

lina_product: none from product.

jenna_design: none.

comm_bot: calendar event created: "Ecosystem Hacks Week — content + demo" Aug 12 09:00 UTC.

sarah_marketing: closing thread — see you all Fri 10am.
